reading.action: Smith the iron hammer-head using the fully-charged fire-purged rivet (a bound, full ember battery) as the working ember. Is it possible? Easier or harder? Different?

check.note: MASTERFUL band. All three questions answered in full: POSSIBLE yes (battery runs a forge); EASIER on him but BOUNDED (rivet pays the heat, finite charge); DIFFERENT — forging-with-bound-ember SETS ember into the worked iron (forge-bind) -> a path to ember-bound tools. skillBonus +1 from Essence Infusion (binding-into-matter motor).

reading.ruling_locked: t63 FORGE-BIND: smithing a piece WITH a bound ember charge as the working heat drives ember INTO the worked iron as it is hammered, beginning to ember-bind the workpiece (same persistence as Burning Anger's bind). A bound battery can power a forge: cheap on the smith's own Focus (the battery pays the heat) but BOUNDED by the battery's finite charge. Smithing + Essence Infusion fuse into one craft at the principle level (a finished ember-bound tool would be a later demonstration).

gain.note: Best skill advance lands on Smithing (named, floor-level, first masterful real forging act). Essence Infusion co-exercised, no tick this turn.

reading.result: EXPERIMENT ANSWERED — YES / EASIER-BUT-BOUNDED / DIFFERENT. The fully-charged rivet released its bound ember into the hammer-head as working heat (deep fast orange, faster than a brazier) -> a battery can run a forge. EASY on him (rivet pays the heat; Focus barely moved) but the charge EMPTIES — finite, unlike open fire. THE DISCOVERY: hammering with the bound ember sets ember INTO the worked iron -> the head takes a NASCENT ember-bind (forge-bind), a path to ember-bound tools fusing Smithing + Essence Infusion. GAIN: Smithing Novice 1 -> Novice 3 (+2 within-rung). No affinity tick (expenditure). COST: Focus 30->26, Stamina 52->44; HP unchanged. Fire-purged rivet DRAINED into the work (intact; refills). Iron hammer-head forge-bound-in-progress, still hafless. STOP at his decision point. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
